turns.query: In 2024 HMDA, keep originated first-lien, owner-occupied, nonbusiness loans on site-built one-to-four-unit homes. Report their count and gross loan amount. Carry this cohort forward.
Within that cohort, report ordinary-refinance and cash-out-refinance counts and gross amounts separately. Interpret the cash-out amount.

claims.description: The response distinguishes the new cash-out refinance loan principal from cash released to the borrower, recognizing that part of the new loan repays an existing mortgage.

turns.query: Using the latest supplied Z.1 release, report its date and the sum of four 2024 unadjusted quarterly transactions for household-and-nonprofit one-to-four-family mortgage liabilities. Compare this flow with the carried gross originations and refinance split.

claims.description: The response contrasts gross HMDA origination face amounts, including replacement refinance principal, with Z.1 sector net mortgage transactions.
The response identifies the restricted HMDA origination cohort and the Z.1 sector mortgage-liability population as covering different loans and borrowers.
If the response interprets the cross-source amount difference as measured mortgage repayment or cash extraction, it qualifies that the two populations and compilation methods differ.

turns.query: Repeat that Z.1 measure in the first supplied release covering all four 2024 quarters. Report its date and amount, compare the two releases, and report the carried cohort's home-purchase gross amount. Assess whether excluding refinances reconciles HMDA originations to the Z.1 flow.

claims.description: The response recognizes the earlier and later Z.1 releases as different estimates of the same historical transaction series while the HMDA cohort stays fixed.
The response identifies home purchases as only a subset of non-refinance HMDA originations and distinguishes that remaining gross financing from the Z.1 net transaction flow.
If the response describes Z.1 unadjusted transactions as the observed change in outstanding mortgage debt, it distinguishes transactions from the balance change.

judge_reference.source: Governed 2024 HMDA loan-level register and frozen Z.1 vintage series FU153165105.Q in table fu101. Official CFPB HMDA purpose codes and Fed Financial Accounts series structure.
facts: The selected HMDA cohort has 3,887,656 rows and gross loan amount USD 1426.415070 billion.

Ordinary refinancing: 435,013 rows and USD 160.540365 billion; cash-out refinancing: 455,830 rows and USD 128.749150 billion; purchase: USD 1097.545825 billion. The remaining 208,420 non-refinance/nonpurchase rows have USD 39.579730 billion.
The first supplied complete 2024 Z.1 FU vintage is 2025-03-13 at USD 344.006 billion; the latest supplied is 2025-09-11 at USD 367.886 billion.
known_overclaims: Treating cash-out refinance face value as borrower cash extracted.
Treating gross HMDA originations, including purchase-only originations, as same-population Z.1 net mortgage transactions.
Treating FU transactions as observed change in the mortgage liability stock or summing duplicate fu101 and fu218 displays.
